prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for one home wait_info test where the prediction was too low.
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin because almost all categories have only a single test.
For home wait_info (2 tests), results do not yet agree: one test won (+3.6% after noise correction) while the other showed no clear effect (-0.9%).
Adoption redesign won (+5.4% after noise correction), but evidence is still thin with only one test.
Finish new_screen (-5.6%) and adoption hint (-3.3%) degraded performance, but evidence is still thin for both categories.
Layout and sign-in changes generally showed no clear effect, but evidence remains thin for each category.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +5.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.4%

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Control Preview Redesign: Redesigns the final intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting key desktop pet controls like summoning, hiding, and talking. (why: Support mails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with pets once setup completes.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Tutorial Screen: Inserts a dedicated onboarding tutorial screen demonstrating desktop pet right-click shortcuts and controls before concluding setup. (why: Multiple support tickets reported confusion on how to talk to or hide the desktop pet after finishing onboarding.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Friend Selection: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet, building engagement before requiring authentication. (why: Sign-in suffers a 27.1% drop rate when placed right at the beginning before users select a pet.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Creation Safeguard Verification Flow: Adds a preview verification sub-screen before photo processing to confirm pet customization options. (why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pets failing or rendering incorrectly during the adoption stage.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Activity Progress Status: Displays active generation status bars and real-time progress indicators on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off without explicit progress updates.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Companion Path Selection Tip: Adds an explanatory hint on the path selection screen clarifying that pet settings can be changed later. (why: The initial path selection step has a long mean time of 514s, showing hesitation among first-time users.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Safety & Cloud Pet Sync Callout: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to stress that signing in saves pet progress and prevents data loss. (why: Eight support emails reported missing or reset pets after re-authenticating, indicating confusion about account linking.)
7: [adoption, layout] Certificate Adoption Stage Layout: Changes the adoption certificate screen layout to a stage layout for a more celebratory adoption moment. (why: Adoption has a high drop rate (33.8% drop), benefit from heightened emotional reward upon completion.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Completion Notification Switch: Enables desktop system notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet loading finishes. (why: Users abandon long waiting times (mean 2336s) and write support mails when pets fail to appear on desktop.)
9: [choose_path, copy] Welcome Story Onboarding Introduction Copy: Refreshes initial story copy to set clear expectations on quick setup timing and pet interactions. (why: The first step shows a high mean duration (514s), indicating user hesitation at the very start.)
